audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for third visit warning, test yourselves, weakness/power of Messiah, restoration prayer, final appeals and blessing.

verses.restored: This third time I am coming to you. Upon the mouth of two witnesses and three every word will stand.

familiar.text: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

verses.restored: I have said beforehand and I say beforehand, as when present the second time and now absent, to those who sinned/misaligned before and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare,

familiar.text: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

verses.restored: since you seek proof of the Messiah speaking in me, who is not weak toward you but is powerful among you.

familiar.text: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

verses.restored: For indeed he was crucified from weakness, but he lives from power of the Divine. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him from power of the Divine toward you.

familiar.text: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

verses.restored: Test yourselves, whether you are in the trust; examine yourselves. Or do you not recognize yourselves, that Jesus Messiah is in you? Unless indeed you are disapproved.

familiar.text: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

verses.restored: But I hope you will know that we are not disapproved.

familiar.text: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

verses.restored: Now we pray to the Divine that you do nothing harmful; not so that we may appear approved, but so that you may do the beautiful/good, even if we may be as disapproved.

familiar.text: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

verses.restored: For we are not able to do anything against the truth, but for the truth.

familiar.text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

verses.restored: For we rejoice whenever we are weak and you are powerful; this also we pray, your restoration/completion.

familiar.text: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

verses.restored: Because of this I write these things while absent, so that when present I may not act sharply according to the authority that the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

familiar.text: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

verses.restored: Finally, siblings, rejoice, be restored, be encouraged/comforted, think the same, live in peace; and the Divine of love and peace will be with you.

familiar.text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

verses.restored: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

familiar.text: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

verses.restored: All the holy ones greet you.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Messiah and the love of the Divine and the fellowship/participation of the holy Spirit be with you all.

familiar.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

translation_notes: Authority is again explicitly for building up, not tearing down.
Restoration/completion in verse 9 and final exhortation in verse 11 frame the whole severe section as repair, not punishment for its own sake.
